G5611.name: Beautiful Gate
G5611.brief: Gate of the Jerusalem temple, site of Peter's miracle.
G5611.short: The Beautiful Gate was a gate of the Jerusalem temple, where Peter healed a lame man. (<ref="Act.3.2, 10">Act.3.2, 10</ref>)

G5614.name: Hosanna
G5614.brief: A Hebrew expression meaning "save now" or "save, please"
G5614.short: Hosanna, a Hebrew expression meaning "save now" or "save, please," was shouted by the crowds during Jesus' triumphal entry into Jerusalem, acknowledging Him as the Messiah (<ref="Matthew 21:9, 15; Mrk.11.9-10; Jhn.12.13">Matthew 21:9, 15; Mrk.11.9-10; Jhn.12.13</ref>).
